name: Shree Ganesh Elastoplast Limited
about: Shree Ganesh Elastoplast Limited invests in capital market and securities in India. The company is involved in sourcing, procurement, storage, transportation, logistics and trading of agro and non-agro commodities, as well as investments and trading in shares and securities. Shree Ganesh Elastoplast Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
